instruction: Candid outdoor medium shot of a couple in a snowy forest. On the right, the smiling woman in the grey beanie (R1) stands in a black leather jacket, holding a black dog close to her face with closed eyes. On the left, the man in the brown coat (R2), wearing a black beanie, leans in to kiss the dog's head. The couple stands close together on a snow-covered path, embracing the pet. Soft, diffused daylight creates a cool winter atmosphere with natural, muted colors and soft shadows.
elements: R1 holds the black dog close to her face
R2 leans in to kiss the dog's head
R1 is the person holding the dog while R2 is the person kissing it
the couple is embracing the pet together
